description.value: Beach Gardens Resort & Marina is a full-service oceanfront resort situated on Malaspina Strait in Powell River, on BC's Sunshine Coast. Each guest room features a private ocean-view patio, and the property includes a 55-slip marina, the award-winning Seasider Bistro, an on-site craft distillery, and a cold beer and wine store. A shuttle service to the Town Centre Mall is available upon request, making the resort a self-contained base for exploring the region.

address.value: 7074 Westminster Street, Powell River, British Columbia, Canada, V8A 1C5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the resort's address, phone, and email match OSM exactly. Laundry (coin laundry for marina guests) and Wi-Fi (complimentary high-speed wireless for all hotel and marina guests) are explicitly confirmed on the website. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, drying area, e-bike charging, or most other cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the fetched content, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM community is tagged 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Powell River is on the BC Sunshine Coast (mainland), not Vancouver Island — community classification may need correction.
OSM name uses 'and' ('Beach Gardens Resort and Marina') while the website consistently uses an ampersand ('Beach Gardens Resort & Marina'); stored as OSM value per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active full-service resort well-suited to touring cyclists in Powell River, but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike procedure could be confirmed from the website. Direct contact is needed to verify these required WWC criteria before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: On-site Cold Beer & Wine Store and shuttle service to Town Centre Mall (upon request) are notable cyclist-friendly conveniences worth confirming in a follow-up call along with bike storage.
